payload.tension: The passage states service supplies need and multiplies thanksgiving. For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God, Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift! It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
